notes.title: UPDATE 0.3.0
notes.notes:
Update 0.3.0

Hey everyone!

Update 0.3.0 is here, and it brings a massive overhaul to the UI, animations, and maps. Every map has been reworked to improve both visuals and gameplay flow, making for a better overall experience. All upcoming maps will follow this updated style, ensuring a consistent and polished feel throughout the game.

Right now, the map selection is smaller as I'm still actively working on them, but my plan is to release a new map every week or two until we reach around 20 maps, each designed with the new improvements in mind.

The animations have also been updated, and while they're still a work in progress, this update is a big step in the right direction. Expect even smoother and more engaging visuals as I continue refining them in future updates.

Thanks for your patience and support as I keep working to make the game better!

notes.title: Some more News about the new Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone Update new time again!

So this week I Decided to make the game with a smaller scope since its just me working on this game.

I've Removed a few gamemodes, The Gamemodes that will be included in the game as of this moment will be Deathmatch, Zombies and Extraction (PLACEHOLDER NAME). The reason for this is because the TDM and other gamemodes that has teams is not going to be an easy task, After I release the base version of this new update, I might take a bit of time to make the system but at this point in time I just want to get this Update to you guys ASAP.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2127310/Deltazone/

notes.title: More news about Update V0.3.0
notes.notes: So I lied. This update will not be for the maps... It will instead be for better animations and just a better overall system for the way I create animations. All Third Person animations will be a little bit simpler, but the first person animations will be a lot better. I realized that remaking all the maps would take a little bit of time, and I didn't want to use that much time on one thing in the game. I might just scrap all the Maps and then slowly make new and better maps.
